sections.section_title: GPIO port input data register (GPIOx_IDR) (x = A, B, C, D, F)
sections.text_helper: Section 8.5.5 "GPIO port input data register (GPIOx_IDR) (x = A, B, C, D, F)" in chapter 8 (General-purpose I/Os (GPIO)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 190.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x10
Reset value: 0x0000XXXX
Bits 31:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 IDy: Port x input data I/O y (y = 15 to 0)
These bits are read-only. They contain the input value of the corresponding I/O port.

fields.name: Res.
fields.description: Reserved, must be kept at reset value.

fields.name: IDy
fields.description: Port x input data I/O y (y = 15 to 0) These bits are read-only. They contain the input value of the corresponding I/O port.
